Bidding resolves the next lot; you may also post an indicative price, announce a bidding ceiling, or sponsor Bidder 1. Scoring: Lots are worth 4, 6 and 10. The highest sealed bid wins and pays its bid; a bid cannot exceed your bank. Each lot won earns a 3-coin commission. Indicative prices and ceilings are public talk, not bids. Sponsoring costs 1 coin and gives Bidder 1 reputation. If Bidder 1 finishes ahead of Bidder 2, you receive a 5-coin finder's fee. Rivals: A live player controls each other seat, choosing its actions from its own observations and the game history.
